title: Decir lo que no haces
communication_goal: Expresar hábitos y acciones que no realizas usando don't con I, you, we y they.
situation: Hablas sobre tu rutina y aclaras qué actividades no forman parte de tu día.

language_focus.function: negative statements in the present simple

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.english: No, I don't. I take the bus.

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.english: Do you drink coffee in the morning?

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.english: No, I don't. We drink tea at home.

dialogue.speaker: Julia
dialogue.english: My parents don't work on Sundays either.
dialogue.spanish: Mis padres tampoco trabajan los domingos.

explanation_es: Para negar acciones en presente simple usa sujeto + don't + verbo base. Don't es la contracción de do not. No agregues s al verbo después de don't: I don't drive, no I don't drives. La negación va antes del verbo principal.
spanish_speaker_notes: No traduzcas 'no conduzco' como I no drive; necesitas don't.
Después de don't siempre va la forma base: don't work, don't eat, don't study.
Don't puede sonar /doʊnt/; practica la contracción como una sola unidad.
Para decir 'tampoco' puedes usar either al final de una oración negativa.

pronunciation.tip_es: La palabra don't debe escucharse, pero no la acentúes más que toda la frase.

reading.title: A different morning
reading.text: Marco doesn't drive to work. He takes the bus. He doesn't drink coffee, either. He drinks tea at home. On Sundays, he and his friends don't work. They play soccer instead.

activities.instruction: Relaciona las actividades con sus significados.

activities.audio_text: No, I don't. I take the bus.
activities.feedback: La respuesta negativa habla de conducir y del autobús.
Con we usamos don't para negar acciones.

activities.instruction: Corrige: They don't works on Sundays.

activities.instruction: Lee: I don't drive. I don't drink coffee. I take the bus.
activities.target: I don't drive. I don't drink coffee. I take the bus.

activities.instruction: Lee A Different Morning y responde: Does Marco drive to work?
activities.feedback: El texto dice que toma el autobús, no que conduce.

activities.instruction: La IA será un compañero comparando rutinas. Responde con frases afirmativas o negativas y explica una diferencia.
activities.scenario: You and a classmate compare morning routines.
activities.ai_language: English with a Spanish hint after two failed attempts

activities.instruction: Escribe y graba cinco cosas que no haces en tu rutina. Añade una alternativa para dos de ellas.
success_criteria: mantiene el verbo en forma base
las frases describen tu vida real

activities.instruction: Sin mirar, completa: I ___ drive. We ___ drink coffee. They ___ work on Sundays.

must_demonstrate: usar el verbo base después de don't
explicar al menos tres hábitos que no realiza
mastery_criteria.retry: Si agregas s después de don't, repite la regla: don't + verbo base.
